## Architecture gate

- [ ] I identified the semantic authority for this change.
- [ ] The change uses the existing control plane unless a missing primitive is demonstrated.
- [ ] No model/tool/protocol/backend gains independent authorization authority.
- [ ] Capability semantics are defined before backend/technology choice.
- [ ] Policy and approval behavior are explicit, including fail-closed paths.
- [ ] Durable state/effect identity/recovery behavior is defined where effects can escape the process.
- [ ] Verification and attributable evidence are defined; model prose is not used as authoritative evidence.
- [ ] External/data egress scope is explicit and minimized.
- [ ] New dependencies, adapters, runtimes, or abstractions have a measured reason to exist.
